summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting its Fiscal Council's unanimous favorable opinion on a proposal to declare Interest on Capital (IoC) of R$230,000,000 (gross), equivalent to R$0.07197382114 per share (R$0.05937840244 net after 17.5% withholding tax), based on the May 31, 2026 balance sheet. The IoC will be credited to shareholders of record as of June 26, 2026; after that date shares trade ex-IoC. The net amount will be allocated to the mandatory minimum dividend for FY 2026, ad referendum to the 2027 AGM, with payment by April 30, 2027. The filing reflects a routine capital return via interest on capital, a common Brazilian dividend-equivalent mechanism. No break fee, price, or premium applies. Watch for final board approval and any tax treaty adjustments affecting net amounts.
